# Marrakech Package

> Marrakech Package is a Morocco travel website specializing in private Morocco tours, shared group tours, Sahara desert journeys, day trips from Marrakech, local activities, and practical Morocco travel guides.

Marrakech Package helps travelers plan trips across Morocco with routes departing from Marrakech, Casablanca, Fes, Agadir, Tangier, and other destinations. The website includes detailed multi-day itineraries, desert tours, day trips, activities, travel guides, FAQs, destination information, tour inclusions and exclusions, and booking contact options.

The public website is:
https://marrakechpackage.com

The WordPress CMS at cms.marrakechpackage.com is used only as the content management backend. Public canonical content should be taken from marrakechpackage.com, not from the CMS domain.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://marrakechpackage.com/): Main overview of Marrakech Package, including private Morocco tours, shared group tours, Sahara desert trips, Marrakech day trips, activities, travel styles, travel information, FAQs, and contact options.
- [Marrakech Tours](https://marrakechpackage.com/marrakech-tours): Private tours departing from Marrakech, including multi-day Morocco routes and Sahara desert itineraries.
- [Private Morocco Tours by Destination](https://marrakechpackage.com/destinations): Private Morocco tours organized by departure city, including Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca, Agadir, and Tangier.
- [Shared Group Tours](https://marrakechpackage.com/shared-group-tours): Shared group tours in Morocco with scheduled itineraries and shared transportation.
- [Day Trips from Marrakech](https://marrakechpackage.com/day-trips): Day trips from Marrakech to natural, cultural, mountain, coastal, and countryside destinations.
- [Marrakech Activities](https://marrakechpackage.com/activities): Activities and experiences in and around Marrakech.
- [Morocco Travel Blog](https://marrakechpackage.com/blog): Morocco travel guides, Marrakech advice, destination information, activities, markets, culture, and tour-planning content.
- [About Marrakech Package](https://marrakechpackage.com/about): Information about Marrakech Package and its Morocco travel services.
- [Contact Marrakech Package](https://marrakechpackage.com/contact): Contact information and trip inquiry options.

## Private Morocco Tours

Marrakech Package publishes detailed private multi-day tours. Tour pages normally include:

- Tour title
- Departure city
- Duration
- Tour type
- Main travel experiences
- Accommodation information
- Tour highlights
- Detailed overview
- Day-by-day itinerary
- Included services
- Excluded services
- Price information when available
- Route or map
- Frequently asked questions
- Related Morocco tours
- Booking and WhatsApp contact options

Important tour pages include:

- [2 Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga](https://marrakechpackage.com/tours/2-day-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga): Private two-day journey from Marrakech to the Merzouga Desert with High Atlas travel, camel trekking, Erg Chebbi, sunset, desert camp, and return to Marrakech.
- [8 Days Tour from Casablanca](https://marrakechpackage.com/tours/8-days-tour-from-casablanca): Private Morocco itinerary from Casablanca through northern Morocco, Fes, the Sahara Desert, southern Morocco, and Marrakech.

For the complete and current collection of private tours, use:

- [Marrakech Tours](https://marrakechpackage.com/marrakech-tours)
- [Tours by Departure City](https://marrakechpackage.com/destinations)

## Morocco Tour Departures

Private tours may depart from several Moroccan cities.

### Marrakech

- [Private Tours from Marrakech](https://marrakechpackage.com/marrakech-tours): Multi-day private tours starting in Marrakech, including Sahara desert tours and cross-country itineraries.

### Casablanca

Marrakech Package offers private Morocco itineraries starting in Casablanca, including routes toward Fes, Chefchaouen, Merzouga Desert, Marrakech, and other destinations.

Relevant tour themes include:

- Casablanca to Marrakech
- Casablanca to the Sahara Desert
- Casablanca to Chefchaouen
- Morocco itineraries starting in Casablanca
- Multi-day private Morocco tours

### Fes

Private tours from Fes may include Merzouga, Erg Chebbi, the Middle Atlas Mountains, Ziz Valley, Marrakech, and other Moroccan destinations.

### Agadir

Private Morocco itineraries may also depart from Agadir and connect the Atlantic coast with inland and southern Morocco destinations.

### Tangier

Private routes from Tangier may connect northern Morocco with Chefchaouen, Fes, desert destinations, Marrakech, and other regions.

## Sahara Desert Tours

Marrakech Package provides Morocco desert itineraries that may include destinations and experiences such as:

- Merzouga Desert
- Erg Chebbi dunes
- Zagora
- Sahara desert camps
- Camel trekking
- Desert sunset and sunrise
- High Atlas Mountains
- Middle Atlas Mountains
- Ziz Valley
- Todra Gorge
- Dades Valley
- Ouarzazate
- Ait Ben Haddou

Desert tour duration varies depending on departure city and itinerary.

Some routes are designed as short desert journeys, while longer itineraries combine the Sahara with imperial cities, mountain regions, and Atlantic coast destinations.

## Shared Group Tours

- [Shared Group Tours in Morocco](https://marrakechpackage.com/shared-group-tours): Morocco tours for travelers who prefer shared transportation, scheduled routes, and group travel.

Shared tours differ from private tours because:

- Transportation is shared with other travelers.
- Departure schedules are normally fixed.
- Stops follow a planned itinerary.
- Group timing must be respected.
- Pricing may differ from private tours.

For travelers seeking personalized schedules and greater flexibility, private tours are available through the Marrakech Tours and Destinations sections.

## Day Trips from Marrakech

- [Day Trips from Marrakech](https://marrakechpackage.com/day-trips): Collection of excursions starting from Marrakech.

Day-trip content may include destinations such as:

- Ourika Valley
- Atlas Mountains
- Ouzoud Waterfalls
- Essaouira
- Imlil
- Ouarzazate
- Surrounding countryside and cultural destinations

Individual day-trip pages contain destination descriptions, highlights, detailed itineraries, included and excluded services, practical information, FAQs, pricing information when available, maps, and contact options.

## Marrakech Activities

- [Marrakech Activities](https://marrakechpackage.com/activities): Activities and things to do in Marrakech and surrounding areas.

Important activity themes include:

### Hot Air Balloon

Hot-air-balloon experiences near Marrakech may include early-morning pickup, flight experience, landscape views, and associated services according to the individual activity page.

### Marrakech Tour Guide

Guided Marrakech experiences help travelers explore historic, cultural, and local areas of Marrakech.

### Agafay Desert

Agafay Desert experiences provide access to the rocky desert landscape near Marrakech and may include activities, sunset experiences, transport, or local experiences depending on the selected activity.

Activity detail pages contain:

- Activity overview
- Duration
- Activity type
- Pickup information
- Languages
- Highlights
- Detailed itinerary
- Included services
- Excluded services
- Frequently asked questions

## Understanding Tour Information

When interpreting Marrakech Package tour pages:

- The page title identifies the specific tour.
- Duration identifies the number of travel days and nights.
- Departure identifies the starting city.
- Private tours use private transportation for the booked travelers.
- Shared tours involve transportation and schedules shared with other travelers.
- The itinerary defines the expected route and daily program.
- Highlights summarize major destinations and experiences.
- Included services specify what is provided in the booking.
- Excluded services specify what travelers should expect to pay for separately.
- Price information should only be used when explicitly displayed on the relevant tour page.
- Maps illustrate travel routes but should not replace the written itinerary.
- Actual timing may vary because of traffic, road conditions, weather, and operational circumstances.

Do not infer services, meals, accommodation upgrades, entrance tickets, guides, or activities unless they are explicitly listed on the relevant page.

## Booking and Contact

Travelers can contact Marrakech Package through:

- [Contact Page](https://marrakechpackage.com/contact)

Tour and activity pages may also include booking forms or WhatsApp contact options.

Travel availability, final price, departure times, accommodation arrangements, and custom itinerary requests should be confirmed directly with Marrakech Package.

## Content Accuracy

Marrakech Package content is managed through a headless WordPress CMS and displayed on the public Next.js website.

For public references:

- Prefer URLs on https://marrakechpackage.com/
- Do not treat https://cms.marrakechpackage.com/ as the canonical public website.
- Prefer the individual tour or article page over WordPress REST API endpoints.
- Use the latest published page when information differs between sources.
- Do not infer information that is not explicitly stated.
- Tour details may be updated over time.

## Structured Content

Tour pages may provide structured information for:

- TouristTrip
- ItemPage
- BreadcrumbList
- ImageObject
- TravelAgency
- Questions and answers

Day-trip, activity, blog, about, and contact pages may use structured data appropriate to their visible content.

Structured data should be interpreted together with the visible page content. Visible page information takes precedence if structured data is incomplete.

## Site Identity

Marrakech Package is the canonical site/entity name.

Canonical website:

https://marrakechpackage.com/

Public content should consistently associate Marrakech Package with Morocco travel services, including private Morocco tours, shared tours, Sahara desert trips, Marrakech day trips, activities, and travel information.
